description: Format SQL (one clause per line, indented sub-queries, CASE blocks, JOIN … ON with AND/OR, CREATE TABLE column lists) or minify it to one line per statement. Options: keyword case (UPPER, lower, keep), indent (2, 4, tab), trailing or leading commas, keep/drop comments when minifying. Dialect-neutral tokenizer: understands -- and /* */ comments, '' and E'\'' strings, "x", `x` and [x] identifiers, $$ dollar quotes, ::casts, JSON operators, :name/$1/? parameters. Only re-spaces; never runs anything. Give "text" or a file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/sql-format/

commas.description: Put list commas at line ends (trailing) or starts (leading).

keepComments.description: Minify only: keep comments (as /* */). Optimizer hints /*+ */ and /*! */ are always kept.

output.description: Optional: also write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/"). The result text is then left out of the reply. Results over 1,000,000 characters are always written to a file.

path.description: Or: a path to a .sql file (UTF-8; use this for big inputs).

name: sql_format
title: SQL format / minify
